subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — draft, timeline options & stakeholder confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.o@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — draft & timeline options (post-discovery)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to capture milestones, owners, and a couple of timeline options so we can pick whichever aligns best with NorthBridge priorities and procurement windows. I’ve attached the draft (NorthBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx) — short summary below.

Quick ask: please confirm the stakeholder list and whether you prefer the Aggressive or Conservative timeline, or a hybrid. If you'd rather, we can lock a 30-minute MAP review next week (I included some slots at the bottom).

Summary (MAP v1)
- Objective: Production inference for patient triage assistant (demo -> pilot -> production). Target close = May 2026 (TBD)
- Milestone 1 — POC kickoff:
  - Target: Week 1
  - Owner: NorthBridge (Liam) / Redwood (Marissa)
  - Dependency: Data access (anonymized sample) + API credentials
- Milestone 2 — Security & compliance review:
  - Target: Week 2-3 (Aggressive) or Week 4-6 (Conservative)
  - Owner: NorthBridge IT / Redwood Solutions (Monica)
  - Dependency: Completed security questionnaire, SOC2 attestation copy
- Milestone 3 — Procurement & pricing approval:
  - Target: Week 3-4 (Aggressive) or Week 6-8 (Conservative)
  - Owner: NorthBridge Procurement / Redwood Sales (Ben)
  - Dependency: SOW + initial usage estimate
- Milestone 4 — Pilot run & metrics validation:
  - Target: 2 weeks after POC
  - Owner: NorthBridge Product / Redwood CS
  - Dependency: POC success criteria met
- Final step — Contract signature & production deploy:
  - Target: Aggressive = ~4 weeks from POC start; Conservative = ~8-10 weeks

Timeline options (high level)
- Aggressive (4–5 weeks): POC start within 1 week, parallel security review and procurement, 2-week pilot. Requires fast access to sample data and procurement prioritization.
- Conservative (8–10 weeks): Sequential security and procurement steps, more time for procurement/legal reviews.

Attachments: NorthBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Proposed next steps
1) Confirm stakeholder list (we have you as primary buyer). Add any IT/security, legal/procurement, or product owners.
2) Pick preferred timeline option or tell us which milestones you want to compress/expand.
3) Share any internal blackout dates or procurement cycles we should avoid.

Availability to review the MAP:
- Tue 10 Mar 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 11 Mar 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 12 Mar 09:00–09:30 PT

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP once you confirm stakeholders and timeline preference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.o@northbridgehealth.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — draft & timeline options (post-discovery)

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear draft. This is helpful. A few items from our side after syncing with IT and procurement: 

1) Stakeholders to add (please include on the MAP):
   - Sara Patel (IT Security Lead) <sara.patel@northbridgehealth.com>
   - Jason Li (Procurement) <jason.li@northbridgehealth.com>
   - Myself (Liam O'Connor) — executive sponsor for clinical side

2) Security: IT wants the security review to be explicit as its own milestone with a deliverable (completed questionnaire + risk review meeting). I attached the security questionnaire they typically use (NorthBridge_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — will ask Sara to fill in her availability.

3) Timeline: the Aggressive option is attractive but only if we can run security in parallel with POC. If not, please show a variant where security is a gating milestone (so procurement waits for completed security review). If you can add a Conservative 10-week option (procurement/legal sometimes take longer), that would be ideal.

4) Procurement ask: can Redwood provide a ballpark TCV and a placeholder SOW line items so Jason can start internal routing? Not an exact number yet — just a placeholder to open the procurement case.

5) POC start window: we can aim to start the POC week of 16 Mar if security & data-sharing paperwork are sorted by 13 Mar.

Happy to review the updated MAP — I can join any of the proposed slots except Tue 10am PT.

Thanks,
Liam
Director of Product Innovation | NorthBridge Health
liam.o@northbridgehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0214

Liam —

Appreciate the clarity and the stakeholder additions. I’ll update the MAP with the items you called out and circulate a V2 ahead of our review. Specific commitments from our side below so you can see owners mapped in the next version: 

- Add Sara Patel and Jason Li to stakeholder table (thanks for the contacts).
- Security milestone: explicit deliverable (completed questionnaire + 1-hr risk review) — Owner: NorthBridge (Sara) / Redwood Solutions (Monica). Monica will reach out to Sara to schedule the review once NorthBridge returns the questionnaire.
- Procurement placeholder: Ben will produce a 1-page SOW + ballpark TCV estimate (placeholder) for Jason to route internally.
- Target close: based on your timing preference, I’m proposing we aim for May 1, 2026 as the target close (this maps to the Conservative/parallel-security variant). If you want to accelerate to April 10, we’ll need procurement prioritized and security sign-off within 2 weeks of POC start.

Next actions from Redwood
1) Ben will draft SOW + TCV placeholder (ETA: Wed 11 Mar).
2) I’ll update MAP v2 with: additional stakeholders, security as a gating/gap option, and a 10-week conservative path.
3) Monica will prepare a short security pre-read and SOC2 material to share with your team.

Proposed MAP review slots (updated):
- Wed 11 Mar 14:00–14:30 PT (preferred for our team)
- Thu 12 Mar 09:00–09:30 PT

Can you confirm which slot works and whether Sara or Jason should join the review? I’ll include a shared Drive link to MAP v2 and the HubSpot deal shortly.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.
